entity.name: Adam Clark
entity.description: Solo developer building sovereign, local-first personal AGI infrastructure. Bad Apple, a persistent personal AGI organism, is the proving ground; the projects listed here are the fully open verification and agent-safety primitives extracted from it and adopted independently.

projects.name: Touchstone
projects.description: Open conformance specification and verification battery for sovereign personal AGI organisms. Thirteen organs (awake, identity, perception, memory, deliberation, action, vigilance, learning, audit, sovereignty, generality, planning, reflection), signed attestations, tamper-evident test vectors, deterministic verdict recomputation, a planted control check that detects rubber-stamping, an independent JavaScript verifier with zero shared code, and a public scoreboard. Already used to produce signed conformance evidence for a real organism and to catch a well-known local agent holding live external connections mid-run.

projects.name: respawned
projects.description: State snapshot and undo layer for agent systems. Content-addressed versioning of an agent's state roots with revert support, used in production inside Bad Apple to snapshot learned state before destructive mutations and daily as a scheduled checkpoint. Published on crates.io.

projects.name: edge_gate
projects.description: Boundary and egress gate for local-first systems: policy evaluation at the edge where an agent's actions meet the outside world. Used inside Bad Apple as the enforcement point that keeps a sovereign organism provably local. Published on crates.io.

plans.name: Touchstone conformance stack hardening
plans.description: Fund a structured hardening roadmap for the open verification stack: expanded test-vector corpus, additional independent verifier implementations, adapter ecosystem for popular agent frameworks, security review of the attestation scheme, and a documented multi-machine mesh-brain conformance run. All outputs published MIT/Apache.

plans.name: Ongoing maintenance of the sovereign stack
plans.description: Sustained maintenance: releases, dependency and security updates, adapter coverage for new agent frameworks, scoreboard operation, and prompt bug fixes across touchstone, respawned, and edge_gate.
